translation.en: hidden people; the Skyborne's own name for themselves, also the name of their language
translation.uk: приховані люди; самоназва небонароджених (Skyborne), також назва їхньої мови

notes: New in WoW Forever. The client pairs the English race name with this lore name in ChrRaces rows 95 (High Order Skyborne, Alliance) and 96 (Windshaper Skyborne, Horde), the same pairing it uses for Blood Elf/Sin'dorei and Night Elf/Kaldorei. Blizzard's own news post gives the gloss 'hidden people'. The client also has a separate language, Languages 310 'Shen'dorei', whose garble word list is identical to Darnassian's (retail 12.1.5 has no row 310 and lists races 95/96 as 'TBD NPC Race'). Overlaps 3-candidates.json; this entry adds the client row IDs.

evidence.where: Languages#310 Name_lang; Faction#2748 Name_lang; Creature#273554 'Shen'dorei Wisp'

evidence.quote: Through your deeds the forest has now become much safer for both wildlife and shen'dorei.
the Skyborne, also known as the shen'dorei or hidden people.

method: Client pairs English name and lore name in the same ChrRaces rows; the gloss 'hidden people' is stated by Blizzard's news post.

translation.en: by blood and honor we serve

notes: Motto on a memorial page for General Turalyon, signed by Uther the Lightbringer. The client gives the English right after the phrase. Word-by-word alignment is not stated (three words against five), and the page does not name the language. Not in the lexicon or anywhere in the repo's git history.

evidence.quote: Esarus thar no'Darador' - By Blood and Honor We Serve.

method: Gloss stated in the same page text.

translation.en: Eldre'Thalas: the ancient Highborne city now called Dire Maul; ancestral home of the Skyborne High Order
translation.uk: Ельдре'Талас: стародавнє місто Високорождених, нині Dire Maul; прабатьківщина Вищого Ордену небонароджених

notes: 'thalas' matches the lexicon's thalas (home/kingdom), as in Quel'Thalas. 'eldre' is not explained in the client.

evidence.quote: This was once a part of Eldre'Thalas - the ancient city of my people that lies just over the southern mountains. Dire Maul, I believe it is commonly called these days.
The High Order is made up of the descendants of the ancient Highborne scholars of Eldre'Thalas.

method: Referent stated in NPC speech and in the race description.

translation.en: Shen'dralar: the Highborne order of Eldre'Thalas (Dire Maul), from which the Skyborne descend
translation.uk: Шен'дралар: орден Високорождених з Ельдре'Таласа (Dire Maul), від якого походять небонароджені

notes: Classic-era name the lexicon never took in. It shares 'shen' with shen'dorei. 3-new-elven-race.md cites Chronicle Vol. 1 for the gloss 'Those Who Remain Hidden'; the client itself only gives the referent.

evidence.quote: I still count myself among the Shen'dralar, but these days I am long estranged from the library I once called home.
Some of the Shen'dralar protested this decision and proposed a compelling alternative

method: Referent stated by faction name and NPC speech.

translation.en: Swordfeather (name of a black owl in Darkshore)
translation.uk: Мечоперо (Swordfeather): ім'я чорної сови в Darkshore

notes: Night elf (Darnassian) naming. The quest gives the English name as an alias; which half means 'sword' and which 'feather' is not stated. Not in the lexicon or the repo history.

evidence.quote: A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

method: Alias stated in quest text ('also known as').

notes: Segmentation shen + dorei (lexicon: dorei = children/born of), as in sin'dorei, kal'dorei, ren'dorei, shal'dorei. Every other 'shen' form in the client fits a hidden people rather than 'sky': Shen'dralar (Highborne order), Shen'dralas (their new zone), Shen'dar (Skyborne highlands and village). Read 'sky' only from the English name Skyborne; that reading does not fit Shen'dralar, so it is rejected.

evidence.quote: the Skyborne, also known as the shen'dorei or hidden people.

method: Segmentation of a Blizzard-glossed compound, checked against every 'shen' form in the client.

translation.en: place, settlement (suffix of elven place names)

notes: Every client name ending in -naar is an elven place: Dolanaar (village), Astranaar (town), Thalanaar (outpost), Falanaar (ancient city), Vor'danaar (prison in the new Barrow Deeps) and the new Skyborne town Valanaar. Compare the lexicon's aran (town/settlement).
method: Distribution across all client place names.

translation.en: Eluvi'ana, the Night Dancer: an ancient Shen'dorei spirit
translation.uk: Елуві'ана, Нічна Танцівниця: давній дух шен'дорей

notes: The client pairs the name with the epithet 'the Night Dancer'; an epithet need not be a literal translation. Pairs with Eluvi'tor (eluvi + ana vs eluvi + tor).

evidence.quote: Raise Eluvi'ana to bind the Ancient Hilt.

method: Name plus epithet in a spell aura text.

evidence.quote: Valanaar Port Authority / Valanaar Central Hall
This missive contains orders from someone located in Valanaar. From the elegant script it seems like a person of status.

notes: Shares 'shen' with shen'dorei; 'dar' is not explained.

evidence.quote: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations

method: Referent stated by the zone table.

translation.uk: Шен'дралас: нова зона Калімдору довкола Долини Кісток у Desolace, з руїнами садів і пілонами мани

notes: New in WoW Forever. Place/people pair with Shen'dralar (-as place, -ar people?), compare Quel'Thalas; that split is inference only.

evidence.quote: Shen'dralas (children include Valley of Bones, Magram Front, Forlorn Gardens)
Once an enchanted necklace that sustained life in the gardens of Shen'dralas.
A shattered pendant with the broken seal of Shen'dralas.

translation.uk: Елуві'тор: Насичене руків'я, яким зв'язують давнього духа шен'дорей

notes: Weapon counterpart of Eluvi'ana. Whether -tor marks a weapon is a guess from this one pair.

evidence.quote: Bind an ancient Shen'dorei spirit using the Imbued Hilt of Eluvi'tor.

method: Referent stated in spell texts.

translation.uk: Тендал: гай, село, печера і стоячі камені на острові Зефрас

notes: Proper noun only; meaning not stated.

notes: Proper noun only. Compare Lake Falathim (AreaTable#441, Ashenvale).
method: Referent stated by the zone table.

translation.en: Zephras Isle: the flying island of the Skyborne in Skywall
translation.uk: Зефрас: летючий острів небонароджених у Skywall

notes: Built on English 'zephyr'. The same stem gives the item prefix 'Zephrali' (32 items, ItemSparse#277080-277111) and the Skyborne surname 'Zephraalis' (NameGen#25277 and others).

evidence.quote: a band of high elven exiles has remained safe / and hidden upon their flying sanctuary of Zephras Isle.

method: Referent stated by zone table and intro cinematic.

translation.en: closing blessing of a Shen'dorei letter (not translated in the client)
translation.uk: прощальне благословення в кінці листа шен'дорей (у клієнті не перекладено)

notes: Written by Lotheluum Starbreeze, a Shen'dorei druid, right before her signature; the line before reads 'I am unsure where the winds will lead you'. 'zepharaalis' shares the zephar- stem with Zephras and the NameGen surname Zephraalis. 'banu' is close to the garble word 'Bandu'. Overlaps 3-candidates.json.
method: Position in the letter (valediction) and shared stem; no gloss in the client.

new: Shindu fallah na! The Thalassian garble list holds 'Fallah' (LanguageWords #854) and the whole phrase 'Shindu'fallah'na' (#896) as one filler entry; the Darnassian and Shen'dorei lists spell it 'Falla' / 'Shindu'falla'na' (#155, #197, #3765, #3780). In-game occurrences can therefore be garble output; keep the gloss only if a non-garble source gives it.
method: Comparison of the client's garble lists; the -h spelling is the only difference between the Thalassian and Darnassian lists.
